6.284 rsInvalidMIMEType
rsInvalidMIMEType is a critical error that occurs when an element that requires a ReportMIMEType
value is not set to a valid value. Specifically, this error will occur if EmbeddedImage.MIMEType or
Image.MIMEType for an Image that has Image.Source set to “Database” is not set to a valid
ReportMIMEType value.
